name: symbolic-clippath
blurb: Image gallery with symbolic SVG clip path shapes on hover.
description: A six-item gallery where images are clipped with various SVG paths (star, diamond, organic shapes). Images zoom and transition padding on hover.
use_when: A portfolio or gallery section with creative image clipping and interactive effects.
avoid_when: When you need to customize clip paths or image sources at runtime — this is a fixed demo layout.
a11y: Images have empty alt attributes. Clip paths do not affect screen reader navigation.
